name: Delia Strong
story: Delia Strong is credited with digital capture for GNS Science’s 1:1 million Geological Map of New Zealand, alongside the map’s geological compilers and GIS cartographer.

Maureen Coomer, Aleksandra Lukovic, Belinda Smith Lyttle and Delia Strong are explicitly credited with digital capture in later national geology metadata. These credits refer to later national geology metadata; the contributors to the first QMAP sheets require separate identification.
SIRC NZ 2013 GIS and remote sensing proceedings citations, University of Otago lists Delia Strong as an author of “Recent ice wastage on the Tasman Glacier from geodetic elevation changes”.
